# Embarko — Live PRD

<!-- Generated by scripts/build-prd.mjs from app/lib/system/story.ts and the code. Do not edit by hand — run npm run prd. -->

## Read this first

Embarko hosts apps that people's AI agents build. It is three repos, and this PRD covers all of them:

- **hostnsoft** (this repo) — Website, panel and admin pages.
- **hostnsoft-api** (`@api`) — Accounts, apps, tokens, domains, billing and Showcase.
- **hostnsoft-deploy** (`@deploy`) — Builds the apps and keeps them running.

This folder is **generated** from the code of all three and from the story file `app/lib/system/story.ts`. It mirrors the admin page at `/admin/system`. Each story below has its own file with the exact screens, endpoints, modules and tables for every step, by ID. The sibling repos are read from `../hostnsoft-api` and `../hostnsoft-deploy`; their part of the scan is saved in `app/lib/system/facts.repos.json`.

IDs: `page:<route>` a screen · `api:<route>` an endpoint here, `api:@api/<route>` and `api:@deploy/<route>` in the others · `lib:<file without extension>` a module (`lib:@api/…`, `lib:@deploy/…`) · `table:store:<name>` site database, `table:api:<Model>` API database, `table:deploy:<name>` traffic database · `ext:<name>` an outside service · `<story>/<step>` a step.

## Purpose

> Embarko lets an app builder get the app their AI built online, see at a glance which apps are live and which need attention and change a live app, or return to a version that worked. It also serves visitors, showcase organisers and platform admins.

_Proposal, built from the stories — not confirmed by a person yet._

## Who it is for

- **Visitors** — People who land on embarko.ai, read about it and browse the Showcase.
- **App builders** — People whose AI agent builds an app, who want it online and healthy.
- **Showcase organisers** — People who run a Showcase page for an event and choose which apps go on it.
- **Platform admins** — The Embarko team, who see every app, message and test result.

## How it is made

- **hostnsoft:** 53 screens · 25 endpoints · 220 modules · 9 tables
- **hostnsoft-api:** 96 endpoints · 121 modules · 19 tables
- **hostnsoft-deploy:** 13 endpoints · 48 modules · 3 tables
- **Stack:** hostnsoft is Next.js on Cloudflare Workers (OpenNext). hostnsoft-api is TypeScript Express with Prisma on SQLite and Redis. hostnsoft-deploy is Node Express, building with Railpack and running apps as Nomad jobs behind Traefik.
- **Store:** Site database — Cloudflare D1 (`DB / DB_ADMIN`), rows readable from the admin page.
- **Store:** API database — SQLite via Prisma (`DATABASE_URL`), structure only from the admin page.
- **Store:** Traffic database — SQLite on the deploy server (`ANALYTICS_DB_PATH`), structure only from the admin page.
- **Outside services:** MSG91 (sign-in and email), Nomad (runs app containers), Traefik (routes traffic to apps), Image registry (stores app images), Railpack (builds app images), Docker (container engine), Lago (billing), Stripe (payments), Redis (rate limits and cache), viaSocket webhook (automation), Google Tag Manager (analytics), YouTube (video embeds), Social share links (sharing)
- **Agent instructions:** [CLAUDE.md](../../CLAUDE.md)

## Keeping it current

1. When a change alters a story, a step, a table or code a story names, edit `app/lib/system/story.ts`.
2. Run `npm run prd` to regenerate this folder.
3. `npm run prd:check` fails while this folder is behind the code or the story.
4. Versions come from git through `scripts/build-system-history.mjs`, which writes the committed `app/lib/system/history.generated.json`.
